intro: Indian e-Visa Online is part of the Unique Visa Services group, a Manchester team that has helped UK travellers with visas since 2008. We check every Indian visa application by hand before it’s submitted.
body: Indian e-Visa Online is run from our office at 61 Mosley Street, Manchester, as part of the Unique Visa Services group. We help people across the UK apply for Indian e-Visas and regular visas, from first-time holidaymakers to families who visit India every year and businesses sending staff on trips.

We’re a private company, not part of the Government of India, and we don’t issue visas. Anyone can apply directly on the official website and pay only the government fee. Our clients choose us because they want a person to check everything: that the visa is the right one, that the photo and scans meet the rules, and that every answer on the form matches their passport.
We show our fee separately from the government fee, we don’t sell “express” e-Visas, and we’ll always tell you if you don’t need us. You can call, WhatsApp, email or visit us.

sections.heading: Why people use us
sections.text:
- A real office you can visit, and people you can call
- Eligibility checked before you pay anything to the government
- Photos and scans fixed for you
- Every application checked line by line
- Help with regular visas, Pakistani origin cases and refusals

sections.heading: How Indian e-Visa Online works
sections.text: You apply online in about 10 minutes, uploading your passport and photo. An adviser checks every answer and document, fixes anything that doesn’t meet the rules, and submits your application. You can call, WhatsApp or visit us at any stage.

faqs.q: Is Indian e-Visa Online the official Indian government website?
faqs.a: No. Indian e-Visa Online is a private company. You can apply yourself on the official website, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee.

faqs.q: Where is Indian e-Visa Online based?
faqs.a: At 61 Mosley Street, Suite 6, Manchester M2 3HZ. You’re welcome to visit by appointment.
A real person checks your eligibility, fixes your photo and scans, and checks every answer before your application is submitted.
